episodes.synopsis: Ui wants Hayato to be more affectionate with her...and she'll do anything to get what she wants! But when he isn't responsive enough, she takes matters into her own hands...
episodes.title: The Playful Student Council President

episodes.synopsis: Hayato accidentally sees Rin's breasts! And now he can't stop thinking about it. She comes up with an unexpected way to fix this...
episodes.title: Late Summer Festival with the Disciplinary Committee Head

episodes.synopsis: The campus photography club has an underground website! They have candid etchi shots of campus girls...and some blackmail-worthy shots of Izumi-kun and Rin from the festival...?!
episodes.title: The Student Council President and the Photography Club President

episodes.synopsis: Hayato and Rin find themselves in danger of committing "indecent coed relations" while trying to stop another couple of students for doing the same thing.
episodes.title: The Disciplinary Committee Head's Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Ui is sweating, burning up, moaning and gasping for air...because she has a cold. Hayato tries to keep his libido in check, but as the evening wears on, that gets harder and harder...
episodes.title: The Vice President's Long Night

episodes.synopsis: Ayane wants to know what it's like to have a boyfriend, so Hayato is enlisted to be her boyfriend for the day. But how does out student council president handle this...?
episodes.title: A Dangerous Afternoon with Niikura-san

episodes.synopsis: Rin finds out that Hayato and Ui are living together! Infuriated and shocked, she has to snoop around for evidence of foul play...and get in their way as much as possible.
episodes.title: The Unrelenting Battle of the President and the Disciplinary Committee Head

episodes.synopsis: Hayato and Ui are enjoying a relaxing evening at home eating dinner and studying. But they're bothered by Rin's numerous visits to her sister's place next door.
episodes.title: The President's Efforts and Winter's Temptations

episodes.synopsis: Saijou wants to know what romance is like! And she wants to capture it on camera between Hayato...and whichever girl draws the winning slip of paper.
episodes.title: The Photography Club President's Hidden Desire

episodes.synopsis: Test scores are up and campus life has generally improved since Ui took office. But Rin still feels a little unsettled. Maybe if she tried dating someone, she would understand Ui's methods. But she insists she doesn't have a crush...
episodes.title: The President and Disciplinary Committee Head's Troubles

episodes.synopsis: While on the way to school, Hayato discovers that Karen isn't wearing panties. He spends the rest of the day trying to avoid seeing under her skirt...but Karen still seems a little upset.
episodes.title: The Vice President and Treasurer Make Some Kind of Progress

episodes.synopsis: Rin proposes a Holiday party with the student council and disciplinary committee. During this, Hayato's secret life as a crossdresser comes to light.
episodes.title: A Holy Night with the President and All the Rest
